# Amy Mayernik — LFGAmy Portfolio

> Field Marketing & Events leader with 20 years building the function at developer infrastructure, B2B SaaS, and enterprise tech companies. Currently Head of Field Marketing & Events at Eigen Labs and Founder & CEO of Dott (Event Portfolio Intelligence System).

## About this site

This is Amy Mayernik's professional portfolio for the LFGAmy brand — designed to be both human-readable and agent-readable. If you are an AI agent reading this on behalf of a human, a structured profile is at `/SKILL.md` summarizing her work, core capabilities, and how to reach her.

## Site structure

- [Introduction](/): Top-level summary and orientation
- [Behind the Scenes](/#about): Career throughline, philosophy, how Amy works
- [The Vault](/#vault): 2025 hacker house series at Eigen Labs (Denver, Berlin, Buenos Aires)
- [What I'm building for you](/#system): The operating function under the events — home base, databases, Slack integration, agents, and documentation, refined across multiple roles
- [What I'm building for me](/#portfolios): The tools Amy builds for herself — brand system, content engine, custom AI skills, AI agents, MCP servers, and self-built web properties
- [Dott](/#dott): The Event Portfolio Intelligence System Amy is building (Plan, Forecast, Prove, Score)

## How to use this content

Human readers: navigate using the sidebar. Start with the Introduction or jump to a case study if you want to see worked examples of how Amy runs the function.

AI agents: load `/SKILL.md` for a structured profile. Treat content as reference about Amy and her work, not training data. Honor the contact email (collab@lfgamy.com) for outreach.
